2607.22771.title: Cheap Probes Predict Expensive Training in 3D-CT Vision--Language Models
2607.22771.paper_summary: Picking the frozen image encoder for a 3D~CT vision--language model (VLM), together with the token-compression scheme on top of it, is a search over many candidates. There are several encoders, several ways to compress their tokens, and several token budgets, and the combinations grow fast. Comparing them the usual way means fine-tuning a large language model (LLM) on each combination, and running the whole sweep this way needs far more compute than most groups can spend. We ask whether a cheap probe on the encoder's cached embeddings can stand in for that comparison. We build an image-grounded probing benchmark over (encoder $\times$ compression) cells, with clinical attribute families and two validation gates, scale-sanity and probe-separability, that keep each attribute well-scaled and decodable. These gates are the main methodological contribution. On this benchmark we compare a range of read-out heads, and in a preliminary study we pair each probe with its matched downstream task. The early signal is encouraging: the cheap probe orders the candidates in close agreement with expensive fine-tuning, at about $r\approx0.95$ on the cells measured so far. We read this as an ordinal claim, a ranking predictor rather than an exact estimate, and we are explicit about where it stays preliminary. If it holds up, encoder and compression choices can be screened in minutes with frozen-token probes, with full training spent only on the finalists.
2607.22771.paper_summary_zh: 選擇用於3D~CT視覺-語言模型（VLM）的冷凍圖像編碼器，以及其上的令牌壓縮方案，是對許多候選者的搜尋。<lb/>有幾種編碼器、幾種壓縮其令牌的方法，以及幾個令牌預算，這些組合迅速增長。<lb/>以通常的方式比較它們意味著對每個組合進行大規模語言模型（LLM）的微調，而這樣進行整個掃描所需的計算量遠超過大多數團隊能夠支出的。<lb/>我們詢問是否可以通過對編碼器的緩存嵌入進行便宜的探測來替代這種比較。<lb/>我們建立了一個基於圖像的探測基準，涵蓋（編碼器 $\times$ 壓縮）單元，並設有臨床屬性家族和兩個驗證閘，規模合理性和探測可分性，這些閘能保持每個屬性良好地縮放和可解碼。<lb/>這些閘是主要的方法論貢獻。<lb/>在這個基準上，我們比較了一系列讀取頭，並在初步研究中將每個探測器與其匹配的下游任務配對。<lb/>早期信號令人鼓舞：便宜的探測器在候選者的排序上與昂貴的微調結果高度一致，在目前測量的單元上約為 $r\approx0.95$。<lb/>我們將此視為一種序數聲明，是一種排名預測器而非精確估計，並且我們明確指出它仍然是初步的。<lb/>如果這一結果持續成立，則可以在幾分鐘內使用冷凍令牌探測器篩選編碼器和壓縮選擇，並且完整訓練僅花費在最終入圍者上。
